set.body:
Journey: See. Track: console. This item gates SEE4, SHARE1 and OPEN1.

Outcome
The owner has approved how the front-of-house screens look and how a person moves between them, before they are built.

Context
The visual language is sound: design tokens, type, light and dark themes, careful focus handling. The gaps seen in the 18 November browser screenshots:
- There is no study page. A dataset opens straight into the file inspector.
- The Access screen searches people by name but still shows and validates a principal UUID, lists only grants made in this browser session, and revokes by grant identifier.
- Add files uses unstyled browser controls. The MRI viewer's plane selector and slider are unstyled.
- Screens lead with digests and rule code names.

Acceptance
1. A navigation model on one page: Home (your labs and studies, shared with you, search), then Study (overview, with sections for Files, History, Sharing and Publishing), with the existing release inspector as Files. Identifiers and digests appear only behind a Provenance disclosure. People appear by name.
2. Static specimens in the existing tokens at desktop width in the light theme, for: Home; Study overview with the participant-by-data-type grid; the Share dialog and access list; Publish readiness; Add data. Dark theme and 390 px for the Study overview and the Share dialog only. Use realistic content from the demo study.
3. A short list of new components (grid, people picker, access row, checklist row, status badges, styled file drop and slider) and which existing ones they reuse.
4. The owner reviews the specimens and approves each or asks for changes. Approval is recorded as a note here. If there is no answer within two working days, building starts from the specimens as proposed and changes are taken afterwards.

Not in scope
Building the screens. A new framework or bundler. A rebrand.

Start from
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.css: the tokens.
- tests/console/specimens and tests/console/hillclimb.json: the existing visual review harness.
- The screenshots under target/console-backend.*.

Evidence
Specimens committed under tests/console/specimens/front-of-house. The owner's approval note.
set.title: SEE1: Design the front of house: Home, Study, Share, Publish, Add data
